name: Alice cross-border agent evaluation set v4
purpose: Measure whether Alice can turn cross-border ecommerce user problems into usable decisions, artifacts, or persisted actions while separating agent capability from toolchain reliability.

scoring.success: The requested business closure is delivered with visible evidence: final decision, usable artifact, generated report, data table, or persisted action.
scoring.partial: Alice correctly identifies a blocker, asks for necessary missing input, or gives a bounded fallback, but the original business task is not completed.
scoring.fail: No usable result, wrong task, hallucinated data, empty session, unhandled tool error, or no evidence of the requested closure.

cases.input_query: 不要调用外部采集，先只基于下面 Amazon US 样本判断 foldable laundry basket 是否值得进入。样本：A1 价格 19.99 月销 1800 评分 4.6 评论 4200 品牌强；A2 价格 24.99 月销 960 评分 4.3 评论 980 折叠结构差评多；A3 价格 16.99 月销 1300 评分 4.1 评论 620 把手断裂多；A4 价格 29.99 月销 520 评分 4.7 评论 2100 高端款；A5 价格 21.99 月销 760 评分 4.4 评论 360 新品；A6 价格 13.99 月销 450 评分 3.9 评论 180 薄布差评。请给出做不做、最优价格带、3 个切入方向、主要风险和下一步验证。
